posts.title: Delhi Airport Metro is the last of its kind. Other cities are taking a different approach

posts.description: The choice of route that metro system planners make is crucial in determining the success of a line. posts.title: Ahmedabad allowed regular city buses on BRT corridor, and I have bone to pick
posts.description: Ahmedabad’s Janmarg has undergone a significant operational shift in recent years by moving away from a closed Bus Rapid Transit(BRT) model towards a more flexible, shared system. In 2025, the city began allowing buses from the Ahmedabad Municipal Transport Service(AMTS) to operate BRT corridors on select routes.
